title: gdpr.erasure.requested
description: stapel-gdpr 0.5.0+ asks every data owner that claims subject_type to erase its slice. This module claims account only — rooms it hosted, admissions to other people's rooms and the presence spans a licence is metered from are all found by one id, the user's, while scope_key and room_key are opaque strings a host's provider computes rather than workspace or meeting ids a scoped erasure could match on. Every other subject_type is ignored (gdpr creates no part for an owner that does not claim it). Documentation of what is consumed: the authoritative schema is the emitter's, in stapel-gdpr/schemas/emits/.
